records.rawDisplayText:
The preview image (og:image) on my site's homepage still shows old text:
the title "Σημειώσεις Μελέτης" and "Καλώς ήρθες! Εδώ βρίσκονται οι
σημειώσεις μελέτης μου..." even though the page's title and description
are current. Please investigate, without changing anything yet:

1. Check whether that old text still appears anywhere in Public/index.md
   or in the site's content/index.md.
2. Check the latest deploy run in my-notes-site's Actions tab and confirm
   it ran after my last homepage change.
3. Find how Quartz generates the social image (which plugin, which fields
   it uses for the title and text, and whether it caches images anywhere).

Tell me what you find and what you'd change.
